description.value: Queens Hotel bills itself as the only hotel in Queensborough, a historic neighborhood of New Westminster, and occupies a quiet residential setting that buffers highway noise. The boutique property offers multiple room types from twin beds to family suites, all with premium Serta pillowtop mattresses and strong Wi-Fi throughout, and is notably pet-friendly with selected pet-friendly rooms. It sits close to the Q to Q Ferry to downtown New Westminster, the Queensborough Landing Outlet Mall, and a cluster of restaurants within walking distance, with a covered patio and BBQ available on-site.
